text:
You need an Android webview app with Firebase integration, and you may want the Apple version after that if this goes well.  

I’m Tobias Reyne, and I’ve spent 7 years building full stack web and mobile-friendly products with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. I recently built a Restaurant ordering web app for Saffron Lane Kitchens using React, Vite, Firebase, Stripe, and Workbox. It was an installable ordering app for 9 restaurants that kept the menu and cart working on bad connections, and 22% of orders came through the app within 2 months.  

I can build the Android webview app and wire in Firebase cleanly. If needed, I can also keep the structure ready for an iOS version later.  

What Firebase features do you want included in the Android app?
